title: Password Validator
description:
Write `is_strong(password)` that returns `True` only if the password has at least 8 characters **and** contains at least one digit **and** at least one uppercase letter.

Hint: `p.isdigit()` tests one character; you may loop over the password, or use `any()` with a generator.
hints: `any(ch.isdigit() for ch in password)` is True if some character is a digit.
solution_code:
def is_strong(password):
    has_digit = any(ch.isdigit() for ch in password)
    has_upper = any(ch.isupper() for ch in password)
    return len(password) >= 8 and has_digit and has_upper
